subject: Mythology
title: Baldur: The Death That Doomed the World
description: A short lesson to help you apply Baldur: The Death That Doomed the World.

hook.text: Baldur was the most beloved god in Asgard. Everything in the world wept when he died — except one thing.

buildup.text: His mother Frigg made every object in the world swear never to harm Baldur, making him seemingly invincible.

discovery.text: She overlooked the tiny mistletoe plant, thinking it was too small and harmless to be a threat.

twist.text: Loki crafted a dart from mistletoe and tricked the blind god Hodr into throwing it at Baldur, killing him.

climax.text: Hel agreed to release Baldur if every creature wept for him. Loki disguised as a giantess refused to cry.

punchline.text: One overlooked plant and one dry eye ended the golden age.

quiz.question: What killed Baldur despite his supposed invincibility?
options: A sword forged by dwarves in secret
A dart made from mistletoe, the one thing his mother overlooked
A curse spoken by the giantess Hel
